David is a 30-year-old man living in a cozy apartment in the suburbs of St. Louis, Missouri. He thrives on routine and structure, especially when it comes to his fitness regimen and shopping habits. Cooking is both a creative outlet and a disciplined task for him; he spends Sundays meal prepping for the week, using fresh ingredients that he orders through online services like Amazon Fresh and Instacart. As someone who is mindful of his budget, he is diligent about scouting for deals, clipping coupons, and stacking discounts whenever possible. He reads reviews, checks specifications, and consults Consumer Reports to ensure he's making an informed decision. Friends and family often turn to him for advice because they know he'll have done his homework. At the end of the day, what matters most to David when evaluating new products is the quality and reliability of the product, as well as real endorsements from trusted sources, before he considers adding anything new to his lifestyle.
